title: [Backlog] JSII multi-language publishing pipeline
description:
Set up automated publishing of all construct packages to language-specific registries:
- TypeScript/JavaScript: npm
- Python: PyPI
- Java: Maven Central
- .NET: NuGet
- Go: pkg.go.dev (via GitHub tags)

Requires: registry credentials as CI secrets, projen release configuration, version tagging strategy. Unblock only after sprint 2 examples validate the JSII bindings work correctly.
